description: Located in the dense rainforest, this waterfall is characterised by a series of cascading tiers and gorges. Adventurers navigate it by "jumping down" short waterfalls into deep, tranquil river pools and narrow passageways. Listed opening hours: 24 hours. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
